sk_slap: slaps a pale ghoul across the face with an open hand so hard its head turns, bells on his sleeve ringing.
sk_cartwheel: turns a cartwheel over a clawed swipe, legs high in the air, bells flying out from his coat.
sk_boo: pops up from behind a tree stump with his arms thrown wide right in the face of a hunched creature, which falls over backwards.
sk_juggle_knives: juggles four thin knives in a high arc by firelight, head tilted back, a pale creature watching the blades uneasily.
sk_curtsy: drops into an exaggerated low curtsy holding out the skirts of his patchwork coat, a thrown bone flying over his bent head.
sk_trip: hooks the ankle of a running grey ghoul with a crooked stick, the ghoul pitching forward into the mud.
sk_jingle: @close-up of a patchwork sleeve sewn with a dozen small brass bells being shaken hard in a thin fist, the bells blurred.
sk_patter: talks fast with both hands going and his head cocked, leaning into the face of a big confused shaggy creature that scratches its head.
sk_leg_up: makes a stirrup of his hands and boosts a wiry hunter in a wolf pelt up onto a high branch.
sk_jeer: points with a straight arm and laughs behind his mask at a hulking creature stuck waist-deep in a bog.
sk_squib: tosses a small smoking clay squib at the feet of three pale creatures, a sharp real flash and a puff of white smoke making them jump apart.
sk_quick_change: is caught in the instant of swapping masks, the white grinning one half lifted away and a bear mask coming up in the other hand.
sk_goat_dance: dances a high-kneed jig wearing a horned goat mask and beating a small drum, pale creatures stamping along despite themselves.
sk_mara_whisper: holds a blank white mask up beside his own masked face like a second head, and the blank mask's mouth seems to whisper into the ear of a frozen creature.
sk_two_stomps: stamps twice on the foot of a tall thin creature, already lifting his knee for the second stamp, the creature hopping.
sk_stilt_kick: balances on tall wooden stilts and swings one stilt in a long kick into the chest of a ghoul far below.
sk_tongue_twister: @close-up of a white grinning wooden mask with a real tongue poking out through the mouth slit, a pale creature beside it clutching its own knotted tongue.
sk_coin_trick: @close-up of thin nimble fingers rolling a tarnished silver coin across the knuckles, a second identical coin appearing behind a grey creature's ear.
sk_pie: pushes a round clay dish of black swamp mud flat into the face of a towering horned creature.
sk_somersault: is upside down in the air mid-somersault over the back of a charging creature, coat-tails and bells streaming.
sk_duet: plays a wooden pipe while a gaunt woman in a linen shift beside him beats a tambourine, the two of them back to back in a ring of listening creatures.
sk_applause: takes a bow with one hand on his chest while his companions around the fire clap and laugh.
sk_wink: @close-up of a white grinning wooden mask with one eye-hole showing a real eye closed in a wink and the other open and bright.
sk_whirligig: spins on one heel with his arms out like a top, the patchwork coat flaring into a disc, small creatures knocked away on every side.
sk_rattle_blow: raps a wooden clapper rattle smartly on the forehead of a kneeling ghoul.
sk_three_masks: @still life: three carved wooden masks hanging in a row on a log wall, a snarling bear, a grinning goat and a blank white face, lit from below by one candle.
sk_knife_act: throws knives in a quick row around the outline of a terrified pale creature pinned against a tree, four blades already quivering in the bark.
sk_once_more: holds up one finger to a weary line of creatures and starts the same dance step again, grinning mask tilted.
sk_heckle: cups a hand to the side of his mask and shouts up at a huge crowned corpse-like figure on a throne, who grips the armrests in fury.
sk_showman: stands on an upturned barrel with his arms spread wide to a crowd of pale creatures and villagers alike, a torch on either side of him.
sk_fire_breather: blows a long plume of real fire from his mouth across a torch at a rank of recoiling pale creatures.
sk_puppeteer: works a wooden cross-bar with strings above his head, and below it a grey ghoul jerks and dances like a marionette.
sk_finale: lands on one knee with both arms flung up as a ring of small squibs goes off around him in real flashes and smoke.
sk_rope_walk: walks a slack rope strung between two pines high above a pit of reaching pale hands, arms out, one foot in the air.
sk_crowd_pleaser: bows low to a half circle of delighted children and old villagers at a fair, a hat full of coins at his feet.
sk_bear_dance: dances arm in arm with a real shaggy brown bear on its hind legs wearing a flower wreath, both stepping in time.
sk_sleight: @close-up of thin fingers lifting a small bone charm from the belt of an unaware grey creature while the other hand waves a red rag in front of its eyes.
sk_mimic_hex: copies the crooked-fingered cursing gesture of a pale witch-like creature exactly, mask tilted mockingly, and she clutches her own throat.
sk_dirge: walks slowly with his head bowed playing a low wooden pipe ahead of a small funeral procession of hooded figures in the snow.
sk_ovation: stands with his head back and arms open as flowers, rags and bones rain down on him from a roaring crowd of the living and the dead.
sk_goat_tricks: rides backwards on a shaggy black goat, holding its tail like reins, the goat butting a ghoul off its feet.
sk_trapdoor: pulls a hidden rope and a pale creature drops straight down through a trapdoor in a rough plank stage, arms flailing.
sk_patchwork: @close-up of thin fingers sewing a fresh red patch over a claw tear in a coat made of a hundred mismatched patches, bells along the seam.
sk_double_act: and an identical second masked jester mirror each other's pose exactly on either side of a bewildered creature that does not know which to strike.
sk_pass_the_hat: walks along a row of pale creatures holding out an upturned hat, and each of them is dropping something into it, a coin, a tooth, a bone.
sk_showstopper: hangs frozen at the top of a great leap in front of a full moon with every creature below standing still and staring up.
sk_puppet_box: @still life: a painted wooden puppet-show box standing open on a stump at night, its little curtain drawn back on two small puppets, a warrior and a skeleton king, lit by a lantern.
sk_deadly_jest: leans in laughing with an arm around the shoulders of a grinning ghoul, while his other hand slides a thin dagger between its ribs.
sk_masquerade: @a ring of dancers in a dark forest clearing all wearing carved animal masks, bear, goat, crane, wolf, impossible to tell which are people and which are pale dead things.
sk_hall_of_mirrors: stands among a dozen tall cracked mirrors propped between trees, each showing him in a different mask, a creature lunging at the wrong reflection.
sk_fear_itself: holds a blank white mask at arm's length toward a towering creature, and the creature cowers from it as if from a monster.
sk_fools_luck: strolls whistling with his eyes shut straight between two creatures that swing at him and hit each other.
sk_hurly_burly: @a wild tangle of a brawl at a village fair: tumbling jesters, a loose bear, overturned stalls, flying bowls and pale creatures all mixed together.
sk_last_laugh: lies on his back on the ground with a hand pressed to his side, head thrown back laughing, as the creature standing over him topples forward with a dagger in its chest.
sk_whole_show: @a rough plank stage in a night forest with the whole troupe on it at once, a bear dancer, a stilt walker, a fire breather, a drummer and a masked jester in front, torches blazing.
sk_swap_roles: swaps masks with an armoured grey-bearded warrior, the warrior holding the white grinning mask to his face and the jester peering out from under an iron helmet.
sk_curtain_call: bows deeply alone on an empty plank stage as a ragged curtain closes from both sides, a single flower lying at his feet.
